info.name: Eraser AI Requests Usage Metrics API

params.name: rangeDays
params.description: Number of days to include in the report. Defaults to 30, min 1, max 365.

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for the report range (YYYY-MM-DD format).

items.docs: Retrieves aggregated usage metrics for the team, including active members, file counts, and AI credit usage over a configurable date range.
